key_insight: Sage-Med-Preview reports stronger medical multimodal performance through progressive training, while model-size scaling alone mainly improves text capabilities.
clinical_relevance: The findings may inform medical AI research on image understanding, report generation, and visual grounding, but do not establish readiness for clinical use.
method: Stage-specific data curation over 322.7 million candidate records.
Medical pretraining, staged supervised fine-tuning, and adaptive reinforcement learning.
evidence_signal: Evaluation against 77 competing models covered 238 tasks across 61 public and 13 private multi-center benchmarks; the reported average on 31 public multimodal benchmarks was 58.26%, versus 50.99% for Hulu-Med-235B-A22B and 52.24% for Intern-S2-Preview.
watch_item: Complex medical reasoning and multi-step clinical workflows remain challenging; benchmark gains do not establish clinical safety or patient benefit.
